searches.name: West Side 1BR Hunt
searches.lookingFor: 1BR+ rental near the Hudson River Greenway, ≤2 blocks to the subway
searches.area: UWS (preferred) · Lincoln Square above W 60th · 2nd tier: Chelsea/West Chelsea and the Lincoln Square edge of the W 50s · no Hell's Kitchen
searches.criteria:
## Context
Lease starting October 1, 2026 (acceptable window: available now through ~Oct 15). Bike is the primary way around town, so the Hudson River Greenway / West Side Highway path is the spine of daily life. Train access still matters: the subway is the backup for weather and late nights.

## Budget
- $3,500–$4,500: great
- $4,500–$5,000: good
- $5,000–$5,500: ok, needs to earn it
- $5,500+: out of range unless exceptional (and no fee)

NYC FARE Act (since June 2025): a landlord-hired broker can't charge the tenant a fee.

## Unit
- 1 bedroom minimum: a true 1BR, separate windowed bedroom with a door.
- Junior 1BR / flex 1 / alcove studio / convertible = not a 1BR.
- Studios are out.

## Location (must-have)
Stay above W 60th St where possible: it keeps home outside the congestion-pricing zone. Tiers:
1. **Upper West Side, W 72nd–W ~96th, west of CPW**: first choice (slight preference).
2. **Lincoln Square, W 60th–W 72nd, west of CPW**: fully in.
3. **Second tier** (inside the congestion zone; worth it only when the unit is clearly better):
   - **Chelsea / West Chelsea, W 14th–W 30th, west of 7th Ave** (west of 9th best, for the greenway).
   - **The Lincoln Square edge of the W 50s**: roughly W 55th–W 59th that reads as Columbus Circle / Lincoln Square rather than Hell's Kitchen: the Columbus Circle blocks, W 57th–59th west toward the river (e.g. VIA 57 West at 12th Ave). A judgment call, not a hard line: a block that feels like Hell's Kitchen (8th–10th Aves in the low-to-mid 50s) is out.
- **Out:** Hell's Kitchen / Midtown West / Hudson Yards proper (W 30th–W ~55th), and anything else below W 60th that isn't in tier 3.

On top of the zone:
- Close to the West Side Hwy / Hudson River Greenway (straight-line distance).
- Within ~2 blocks of a subway entrance: ≤0.15 mi ideal, >0.25 mi fails.

## Red flags
- Move-in later than ~Oct 15.
- Outside the zones above.
- "Model pictures represent finishes".
- Same agent template reused with contradictory details.
- Rent far below market for the block.
- Any deposit/application money requested before a viewing.

## Scoring (100 pts + modifiers)
| Category | Weight | Points |
|---|---|---|
| Greenway proximity | 25 | ≤0.30 mi: 25 · ≤0.50: 20 · ≤0.75: 12 · farther: 5 |
| Subway within ~2 blocks | 20 | ≤0.12 mi: 20 · ≤0.20: 16 · ≤0.25: 10 · farther: 3 |
| Price | 15 | ≤$4,500: 15 · ≤$5,000: 12 · ≤$5,500: 8 |
| True 1BR | 15 | Real: 15 · jr/flex: 6 · studio: 0 |
| Oct 1 move-in | 10 | Now/Oct 1: 10 · unconfirmed or by Oct 15: 6 · later: 0 |
| Building | 10 | Elevator, laundry, doorman/packages, bike storage |
| Light & character | 5 | Exposure, ceilings, prewar detail, good architecture |

Zone modifiers: +3 UWS (W 72nd–96th) · 0 Lincoln Square (W 60th–72nd) · −8 second tier (Chelsea / West Chelsea / Lincoln Square edge of the W 50s) · −30 anywhere else (out of zone).
Other modifiers: +3 W/D in unit · +2 bike room · +2 no fee · −3 walk-up above 2F · −5 subway >0.25 mi · −5 greenway >0.75 mi · −5 model photos · −10 reused template · −20 outside move-in window

sources.name: craigslist
sources.notes: Best route: sapi.craigslist.org/web/v8/postings/search/full with searchPath=apa&min_bedrooms=1&min_price=3500&max_price=5500&postal=<zip>&search_distance=<mi> returns lat/lon per posting - query 10023/10024/10025/10011/10001/10019 and filter by grid position. The static /search page ignores most of the pool (~200 cap). Detail pages give address, data-accuracy (5-10 = exact, 20+ = approximate), availability, laundry. Watch for agents reposting the same template with shifting prices; 'Galaxy Towers' / 'Two Bedroom Two Bath Condominium' at lon ~-73.999 are in NJ (North Bergen/Guttenberg), not the UWS.

sources.name: listingsproject
sources.notes: No bot wall. Paginated /rentals and /sublets fully (216 listings across ~15 pages each) - explicit availability range on every card. No in-zone 1BRs at $3.5-5.5k this pass: inventory is rooms, short sublets and Brooklyn; closest was a 1-week UWS sublet (Oct 6-12). Filters (borough/price) aren't URL-addressable, so the saved links are the category pages.
